protocol.adaptation: 3 of 12 translators; 384 training and128 held-out tokens from disjoint records of pinned Pile test prefix, independently truncated32-token contexts; original used250steps,2^18tokens/step,2048contexts,LR1.0,16.4M evaluation tokens. This does not reproduce original quantitative benchmark or language-model pretraining.
protocol.batch_order: Cycle training records in ascending order; each record is one batch with independent causal context
protocol.checkpoint: save ordinary Burn translator and optimizer records halfway, reload, compare one resumed optimizer step against uninterrupted control, then finish from loaded state
protocol.initialization: h + Linear(h), Linear weight and bias zero; no released lens weights are read
protocol.loss: mean KL(teacher final distribution || translated distribution), full 50304-token vocabulary, natural logs; frozen teacher, final normalization and vocabulary readout
protocol.metrics: held-out KL and next-token CE before and after fixed training; validation never used for stopping/model selection
protocol.stage_definition: 0 is embedding; i>0 is residual_post at decoder block i-1, before the next block; raw residual before final LayerNorm
protocol.validation_policy: Only initial and final held-out evaluations. No fitted effect-size threshold; require final held-out KL lower than initial raw lens separately at each selected stage. Report CE independently, including failures.
